dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous 2D narrowing from the widest mid-thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized asymmetrical bulge on the left lateral margin at approximately mid-body length; the right margin exhibits a smoother, more continuous curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white skin tone with uniform reflectance across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct linear, shadow-casting longitudinal indentation along the central dorsal axis of the posterior half, indicating a prominent dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, circular high-contrast dark point at the anterior dorsal midline, identified as the blowhole aperture.
